_doc: Forge V2 WAVE G1 (2026-07-19) — DORMANT catalog of known MCP servers a Boss MAY be granted access to (see mcp-grants.json for the per-Boss least-privilege matrix). This file is a REGISTRY only: it never installs, connects to, or activates anything. Every entry's 'status' MUST start (and stay, until the owner explicitly opts in) at 'not-installed' — 'active' is FORBIDDEN in this file; forge-mcp-gate.cjs::status() treats any non-registry activation signal without a matching opt-in marker as a hard error. Tiers (least-privilege, doctrine #2): 0 = read-only LOCAL (docs/LSP read) · 1 = read-only REMOTE (web search, docs fetch, GitHub READ) · 2 = SANDBOXED action (browser-QA drive, no persistent writes) · 3 = WRITE-PRIMITIVE (any mcp write: GitHub write, file write, deploy, publish) — tier-3 tools ALWAYS route through forge-actiongate.cjs, never auto-used. Opt-in marker: an entry becomes usable only when config/orchestration/mcp-opt-in.json (owner-authored, not shipped by Forge) lists its id — absence means dormant/native-fallback, logged honestly (event mcp_native_fallback).

servers.purpose: Up-to-date library/API documentation lookup (versioned docs, not stale training data).
servers.install_hint: MCP host config: { command: 'npx', args: ['-y', '@upstash/context7-mcp'] } — see https://github.com/upstash/context7
servers.notes: Read-only docs fetch. Tier 1 because it is a remote network read, even without credentials.

servers.purpose: Browser automation for QA/visual verification — drive a real browser, no persistent writes outside its own sandboxed profile.
servers.install_hint: MCP host config: { command: 'npx', args: ['-y', '@playwright/mcp'] } — see https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp
servers.notes: Sandboxed action tier: it can click/type/screenshot a page it navigates to, but that is ephemeral browser state, not a project write-primitive.

servers.purpose: Chrome DevTools Protocol automation — performance traces, console/network inspection, screenshot QA.
servers.install_hint: MCP host config: { command: 'npx', args: ['-y', 'chrome-devtools-mcp'] } — see https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp
servers.notes: Sandboxed action tier, same reasoning as playwright — a browser-QA driver, not a repo/system write-primitive.

servers.purpose: Read-only GitHub access — issues, PRs, code search, file contents.
servers.install_hint: MCP host config: { command: 'npx', args: ['-y', '@modelcontextprotocol/server-github'] } scoped to a READ-ONLY token — see https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server
servers.notes: SPLIT from github-write per doctrine #4/#2 — a read token must never also carry write scopes.

servers.purpose: Write GitHub access — create/update issues, PRs, commits, branches, releases.
servers.install_hint: MCP host config: same server as github-read but with a WRITE-scoped token — see https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server. Keep the token in env, never in a committed file.
servers.notes: WRITE-PRIMITIVE (doctrine #3): every use ALWAYS routes through forge-actiongate.cjs; never auto-used; requires an explicit per-use owner grant, exactly like deploy/push/spend.

servers.purpose: Neural/semantic web search for current information and research.
servers.install_hint: MCP host config: { command: 'npx', args: ['-y', 'exa-mcp-server'] }, EXA_API_KEY in env — see https://github.com/exa-labs/exa-mcp-server
servers.notes: Read-only remote search. Credential is a search API key, not a write scope.

servers.purpose: Web scraping / page-to-markdown extraction for research and content ingestion.
servers.install_hint: MCP host config: { command: 'npx', args: ['-y', 'firecrawl-mcp'] }, FIRECRAWL_API_KEY in env — see https://github.com/mendableai/firecrawl-mcp-server
servers.notes: Read-only remote fetch/scrape — respect robots.txt/rate limits per this project's scraping doctrine even when opted in.

servers.purpose: Semantic code intelligence via a real language server — go-to-definition, references, symbol search.
servers.install_hint: MCP host config: { command: 'uvx', args: ['--from', 'git+https://github.com/oraios/serena', 'serena', 'start-mcp-server'] } — see https://github.com/oraios/serena
servers.notes: Purely local read (LSP over the project's own source) — no network call, lowest tier.
